preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID — required at Interchange (Village Church & St. Mark AME) and Jewish Community Pantry; helpful elsewhere
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) to confirm no appointment is needed before your first visit
Call Capuchin House of Peace (414-933-1300) — hours last verified 2024; confirm before traveling
Call Maccanon Brown (414-404-0600) — confirm they serve 53206 and hours are current
Call COA Goldin Center (414-265-7696) — confirm they serve 53206 and Saturday hours
At every pantry: ask specifically for no-cook or ready-to-eat items — you have no kitchen
St. Vincent de Paul kitchens: ask about cost on arrival — not stated on official page
Sunday (Sep 13): no confirmed breakfast/lunch program found — plan for pantry items from a prior pickup
res-001 (Northside Community Pantry) has a once-per-7-days visit limit — plan your single visit accordingly
unmet_needs: Sunday Sep 13: no confirmed breakfast or lunch program — gap for morning/midday meals
No kitchen: pantry items must be no-cook/ready-to-eat; availability of such items is not guaranteed
res-003 (Fresh Fixture Mobile Market) excluded — paid option, zero budget
Quantity per visit unknown at all locations — food coverage cannot be guaranteed
data.explanation: Seven free or no-cost options across 53206 and nearby Milwaukee, reachable by bus. No kitchen — every pantry visit is conditional on requesting no-cook/ready-to-eat items. Meal programs (The Gathering, St. Vincent de Paul kitchens) need no cooking. res-003 (paid market) is excluded — zero budget. Appointment status is unconfirmed at several sites; call ahead. All hours are from reviewed records; call to confirm before traveling.
